title: CHIDIST: 152 of 195 counted rows on the campaign's own fitted corpus
status_plain: CHIDIST rose from 12 of 195 before the campaign to 144 after the GRATIO port and 152 after the chopped-exp landing, and 152/195 is confirmed as the post-lane-3 production standing number. The corpus is the campaign's own working CHIDIST corpus -- the target of the repairs it scores -- not a held-out gate; the held-out gate for that landing was a different corpus (b20, +3 of 111). Three other CHIDIST figures in the same lane are not pass rates at all: 16 equal / 17 not equal is a publication-structure probe, and the two 160/160 cross-view figures are Excel-versus-Excel identities recorded with the erf lane.
